description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of reference answers and test cases within a dataset. The chart contains three slices, representing the categories “Have reference answer”, “Have test case”, and “Null”. The “Have reference answer” slice is light blue and occupies approximately 38.9% of the chart, while the “Have test case” slice is light green and takes up roughly 21.9%. The “Null” slice is pink and comprises approximately 39.2% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest and proceeding to the smallest. A legend is included to identify the categories and their corresponding colors.
